name: firstpair-reader
description: FirstPair Reader and FirstPair Triptych, Obsidian plugins for reading and reviewing books in a vault.

scripts.check: python3 scripts/bundle-obsidian-plugin.py plugins/firstpair-reader --check && python3 scripts/bundle-firstpair-triptych.py --check && node --check plugins/firstpair-reader/main.js && node --check plugins/firstpair-triptych/main.js
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test tests/test-support.cjs tests/test-firstpair-reader.mjs tests/test-firstpair-reader-dom.mjs tests/test-firstpair-reader-books.mjs tests/test-firstpair-reader-contract.cjs tests/test-firstpair-triptych.cjs
